group_norms.norm_text: The club shares the route plan in the chat by Friday evening so everyone can plan their weekend accordingly.
Everyone does the post-run social — whether that is the cafe or the pub — it is part of the club culture.
The club runs at a pace where no one gets left behind on the main group run.
Members are expected to let the group know in advance if they cannot make a session.
The club does a post-run coffee at the Arch Cafe after Saturday long runs.
